Name: (Unique Courtship Response) SVE Unique Courtship Dialogue for Lance
Author: brifoundthebingus
Description:
Adds unique dialogue to Lance for birthday gift responses, bouquet and pendant responses, and a couple of others. This is a very small mod and does not cover every dialogue key in the Response CORE, only the lines I was interested in. 13 lines total have been customized if we leave out the duplicate "A" and "B" responses. This includes some different dialogue for birthday gifts if he is your spouse vs. your friend. Regular gift dialogue is unchanged as I do not see a need to change what is already there in base SVE.

Along with Content Patcher, SMAPI, and SVE, you will need MissCoriel's Response CORE and Unique Courtship 5.

[b]Install like any other mod: extract the contained [UCR] folder into your mods folder.

[/b]I may do packs for other SVE characters in the future, or update this one to be a comprehensive pack. Lance's manner of speech is the most fun for me to write dialogue for, and the SVE character I have seen the most in-game content for. My interest kind of falls off rather quickly, after him. I am planning to look at the NPCs that SVE 2.0 will bring, but 2.0 is still a long way out, last I checked.

Note there can be some weirdness with Unique Courtship 5 if you're gifting a) a birthday gift for the first time and b) any particular character for the first time.

- The first time you gift a birthday gift, you may get a weird dialogue answer box. That shouldn't happen a second time over the course of your save file.

- If the first time you give a character a loved gift is their birthday, in my testing they will always use the liked birthday gift response instead of the loved birthday gift response. This is remedied by giving them something they love at any point before their birthday. After that, a loved birthday gift will use the loved response. I am unsure if this happens once per save file or once per game session. I will edit this description if I figure that out.
